overview: A NestJS implementation of the RealWorld/Conduit API specification -- a Medium-style blogging platform with articles, comments, tags, user profiles, and JWT authentication. It supports two interchangeable persistence layers (TypeORM/MySQL on the main branch, Prisma on a separate branch) and is meant as a reference example of CRUD, auth, and NestJS architectural patterns.
services: HTTP REST API server for articles, comments, and user profiles
